title: Recent advances in enyne cycloisomerization using N-heterocyclic carbene gold complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36249-36271
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05920H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahmed Hassoon Mageed
This review highlights the advances in Au(NHC)-catalyzed enyne cycloisomerization, including 1,n-enyne and oxidative pathways, emphasizing mechanistic insights and the role of NHC ligands in enhancing reactivity, selectivity, and stability.
